summary: Practise booking-curve analysis, demand forecasting and pricing decisions. Explore revenue management training and build a practical action plan.
lede: Revenue management helps pricing, sales and commercial operations professionals connect demand forecasts with pricing, capacity and channel decisions. You will practise segmenting demand, analysing booking curves and comparing forecasts with actual results, then use ADR, RevPAR and channel contribution to shape rate and inventory recommendations. Spreadsheet exercises apply these measures to forecasts, scenario decisions and KPI summaries that explain assumptions and performance variances.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage pricing, inventory, demand forecasts or commercial performance and need to connect those responsibilities to revenue outcomes.
outcomes: Price Ladder And Rate Fence Design
